title: The Tomb of the Careful Tax
story: Deep under the chapel, Halbrecken the Dust Collector taxes anyone who tries to carry the orphanage's inheritance out of the crypt. His shroud shimmers with numbers, and he takes a percentage at every door. Mr 6 counts doors before he counts coins.
question: Mr 6 carries 800 silver coins out. At the first door Halbrecken takes 25%, and at the second door he takes 20% of what is left. How many coins does Mr 6 carry into the daylight?
hint: Take 25% off the 800 first. The second toll of 20% is charged on the smaller pile, not on the original 800.
victory: Mr 6 stepped into the sun with exactly 480 coins and a receipt he wrote himself. Halbrecken, impressed by proper bookkeeping, waived the third door entirely.
imagePrompt: A tall shroud-wrapped collector made of swirling dust and glowing numerals standing between two stone crypt doorways lit by green torchlight, as a caped numeral 6 knight hauls a heavy coin sack past him.
